subject: Re: StageGate: Uptick Playbook + KPI audit for renewal
messages:
From: Aaron Li <aaron@tandemai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya@tandemai.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Tandem Q3 usage + renewal check-in

Hi Kimberly / Ben —

Quick note ahead of next week's renewal planning: we attached the Q3 token export and a short summary. High-level takeaways:
- Monthly tokens tripled after V2 rollout (peaked mid-Oct).
- Latency complaints down ~25% since you moved us to the dedicated pool; that’s been great.
- We see material variance across endpoints — chat-heavy endpoints are the primary spend.

We’re targeting a renewal in mid-December. Before we lock terms, PMs want a short ROI recap for the last six months and a proposed StageGate for any capacity uplift so we can validate ROI to finance. Can you run a quick KPI audit (latency, error-rate, cost-per-1k tokens) and propose staged capacity/term options (12/18/24mo)?

Attachments: Tandem_Q3_token_report.pdf (token export + monthly charts)

Thanks — Aaron
Aaron Li
Head of Product, TandemAI
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Li <aaron@tandemai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priya Suresh <priya@tandemai.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tandem Q3 usage + renewal check-in

Aaron —

Thanks for the report and callout. Ben and I dug through the export this morning and put together a short playbook and staged uplift proposal attached (stagegate_playbook.xlsx). High-level summary here so PM + finance can scan quickly:

- Cost dynamics: weighted cost-per-1k tokens increased ~2.6x due to higher sequence lengths in chat endpoints; however, dedicated pool savings offset ~18% of that at current utilization.
- Performance: P95 latency improved from 420ms -> 310ms after the dedicated migration; error-rate steady at ~0.4%.
- ROI snapshot: based on Tandem’s reported feature engagement and attribution model, incremental revenue per 100k messages suggests a 6–9 month payback for a conservative 20% capacity uplift.

Proposed StageGate (attached):
1) Gate 0 (baseline) — keep current dedicated commit; commit to a 6% headroom allocation for Q1 (no term change).
2) Gate 1 (30% uptake) — if usage stays > +25% MoM for 6 weeks, enable burst credit and enable reserved uplift to cover 30% extra capacity for next quarter.
3) Gate 2 (sustained growth) — trigger 12–18 month term amendment for a permanent capacity increase with bumped discount ladder (details in sheet).

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to send econ scenarios and a simple amendment draft for 12/18/24mo (numbers only) — by EOD Friday.
- Marissa to prep a 1-page ROI slide for Tandem finance (calls out latency gains + retention lift) — by Monday.
- Aaron / Priya to confirm which endpoints they plan to prioritize for uplift (chat vs async inference) so we can model correctly.

Attaching stagegate_playbook.xlsx and a short note in the Drive.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: stagegate_playbook.xlsx (staged uplift scenarios, kpi audit, financials)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aaron Li <aaron@tandemai.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tandem Q3 usage + renewal check-in

Adding the deal economics here (summary):

- Baseline (no term change): monthly commit remains; expected Q1 spend variability covered with 30% burst credits at current rate card.
- 12mo uplift: +30% reserved capacity, 8% blended discount vs hosted prices; projected 7-month ROI on uplift if uptake assumptions hold.
- 18mo uplift: +50% reserved, 12% discount, improved SLOs (lower throttling risk) — projected 5-month ROI.
- 24mo enterprise: +75% reserved, 15% discount, dedicated support SLA; projected 4.5-month ROI (best for finance if Tandem is confident in growth).

Risks we called out in the model: endpoint token skew, model mix (devs swapping to higher-cost model variants), and burst pricing exposure during peak testing. I included a sensitivity tab in the StageGate sheet showing different sequence-length mixes.

Ben — attaching econ snapshot to the Drive link Kimberly shared.

On the asks: I can draft the 12mo redline template and an amendment summary by Monday EOD.

-Ben
Account Director | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Suresh <priya@tandemai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aaron Li <aaron@tandemai.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tandem Q3 usage + renewal check-in

Thanks team — helpful materials. Quick notes after a sync with finance and infra:

- Finance likes the staged approach; they requested a 3-line executive summary they can drop into the approval packet (cost delta, expected payback, recommended term). Could Marissa produce that by Friday?
- Infra asks for more granular token-by-endpoint latency tables (they want to see P95 and error-rate for the top 4 endpoints across the last 90 days). Aaron has exported that but can you confirm format? CSV preferred.
- On endpoints: we want the uplift scoped to chat-endpoints only for Gate 1 — async inference to remain at baseline for now.

If we get the exec summary + the 90-day latency CSV by Friday, we’ll schedule a finance review next Tuesday and aim to confirm the amendment scope by 15 Dec.

Priya
Head of Operations, TandemAI
